**Finding submitted: WARRANTY — deviation (fallback cure).**

- **What I found:** Article XV gives only Effective-Date corporate/authority reps (p0681) and Array IP reps (p0691–p0703), followed by a mutual disclaimer of implied warranties (p0711). Article IX defers all product specifications and quality terms to future clinical/commercial supply and quality agreements (p0501, p0510) with no conformance warranty and no remedy. Searches for "warrant", "Specifications", and refund/replace/non-conforming language turned up no express performance warranty anywhere.
- **Classification:** Fails every fallback element (no conformance warranty, no period, no repair/replace, no refund), so a deviation rather than a fallback-acceptable clause.
- **Cure:** One insert of new Section 15.5 at the fallback level — 90 days for deliverables/software against documentation, 30 days for services, with repair, replacement or refund at Ono's election. No carve-out from 15.4 was needed because it is already prefaced "Except as otherwise expressly set forth in this Agreement."
